method.name: registerParkOfferProvider
method.signature: registerParkOfferProvider(provider: (repo: string, unit: UnitRef, actor: string) => boolean): void
method.purpose: Lets the handoff module say whether the acting user has unparked local work for a unit, so the gate can set offerPark on a held-by-other outcome without importing the handoff module (same shape as registerCompletionHook; shipped with no provider, so offerPark stays false).

body.rationale: offerPark exists on GateOutcome but nothing can set it: the gate cannot know about local runs or drafts, and importing the handoff module from the gate would create a cycle. A provider registration, declared by sc4 and registered by s6, is additive and mirrors the completion hook s5 already ships unregistered.
